2558-6277-8095--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-6277-8095--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
On Wings of Gold triggers. Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token. The +1/+1 bonus from On Wings of Gold is countered by the -1/-1 from the templated card
Repeat from step 2.

851-2457-4289-8296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2783-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

579-5137-6723.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-8176.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Repeat.

2738-4556-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

489-1090-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-2350-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
2034-6972-7607.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

81-215-3464.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2116-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
2116-5231-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands

1719-3525-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.

2438-3845-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-5223.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-5223.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

5411-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5411-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

3591-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
3591-5796-6282.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Necropotence triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Discard cards down until your maximum hand size, as the cleanup step is still onging.
Repeat from step 2.

2585-3767-3918-5929.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2585-3767-3918-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
2585-3767-3918-5929.description:
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

92-1561-3045-6317.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw half your library and lose half your life total, rounding up each time.
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Martyr of Sands by paying {1}, revealing all white cards in your hand and sacrificing Martyr of Sands, causing you to gain 3 life for each card revealed this way.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.
92-1561-3045-6317.notes: The pre-requisites state {W}{W}{W}{W}{W} because Celestial Dawn forces you to use white mana to pay for colored mana costs, as it turns all other colored mana into colorless. You must add the white mana and then use it when applicable as black mana.

1309-1987-2187-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1309-1987-2187-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Possessed Skaab.
When Salvager of Secrets and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-2187-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

236-478-804-2821-6071.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
236-478-804-2821-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
236-478-804-2821-6071.description:
Animate Candelabra using Bring to Life.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and The Core.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

225-565-1987-4863.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-4863.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Revolutionist and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Revolutionist.
When the land and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, Revolutionist and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-4863.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

2558-3698-4848-5687.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-390.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Hulking Metamorph.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Hulking Metamorph and another permanent you control.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1527-2415.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of Treasure tokens greater than the indestructible creature's toughness.
1527-2415.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate a Treasure token by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to the indestructible creature.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3987-4064.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Abuelo. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3969-4050-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Knight of the Last Breath, adding {C}{C}.
When Knight of the Last Breath dies, its afterlife ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Knight of the Last Breath trigger, creating three 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Knight of the Last Breath from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

231-1479-3390.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land.
231-1479-3390.description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning any land to your hand from the battlefield, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Lotus Bloom enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land enters the battlefield untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

1494-2646-4013.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
1494-2646-4013.description:
Activate Eldazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1762-2034-2144-3615.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
1762-2034-2144-3615.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wilhelt, adding {C}{C}.
When Wilhelt dies, Myrkul triggers, exiling Wilhelt from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Wilhelt that is an enchantment.
Cast Humility by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, {C}{C}.
When the Zombie dies, the Wilhelt token triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed, which becomes a 1/1 Zombie without decayed due to Humility.
Repeat from step 4.

2645-4178-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Forests.
2645-4178-4657.description:
Activate five Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Nissa triggers five times, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five Forests.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

4038-4315.notablePrerequisites:
Careful Cultivation attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
4038-4315.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

483-803-1033-2869-4302.description:
Cast Captain's Call.
Two of the tokens die to the legend rule.
Cruel Celebrant and Bishop of Wings both trigger twice.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant triggers causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings triggers creating two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
One Spirit token dies to the legend rule.
Cruel Celebrant and Bishop of Wings both trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Repeat from step 6.
